name: DL3DV-10K
description: DL3DV-10K is a large-scale scene dataset designed for deep learning-based 3D vision tasks, featuring over 51 million frames from 10,510 videos across 65 types of point-of-interest locations. It covers diverse scene types including bounded and unbounded scenes with varying reflection, transparency, and lighting conditions, enabling comprehensive benchmarking of neural radiance field (NeRF) and novel view synthesis methods.
reputation: A newer 3D vision dataset that is gaining attention for large-scale novel view synthesis evaluation, but it is not yet as widely adopted as long-standing NeRF benchmarks.
notes: Dataset includes 51.2 million frames from 10,510 videos; covers diverse scene types; benchmarked recent NVS methods; supports learning generalizable NeRF models.
